articles.title: Intel Shares Surge as AI Drives First-Quarter Revenue Jump
articles.summary: Intel reported strong Q1 results with AI-driven revenue growth, causing shares to surge significantly. The chipmaker shows signs of turnaround with AI boom for CPUs gaining momentum.

articles.title: OpenAI CEO Apologizes to Tumbler Ridge Community
articles.summary: Sam Altman issued a formal apology to the Tumbler Ridge community in Canada following a mass shooting incident where OpenAI failed to report a suspect's account to police authorities.

articles.title: Meta to Cut 10% of Workforce in AI Push
articles.summary: Meta announces plans to lay off approximately 8,000 employees (10% of workforce) while closing 6,000 open roles as the company intensifies its focus on artificial intelligence development.

articles.title: Google to Invest Up to $40 Billion in Anthropic
articles.summary: Google commits to invest up to $40 billion in AI rival Anthropic, following similar investment patterns as its previous OpenAI cloud deal, signaling intensified competition in the AI space.

articles.title: Nvidia Stock Closes at Record, Pushing Market Cap Past $5 Trillion
articles.summary: Nvidia's stock reached a record high, pushing the company's market capitalization beyond $5 trillion, driven by continued strong demand for AI chips and technology.

articles.title: DeepSeek Unveils New AI Model Tailored for Huawei Chips
articles.summary: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek launched a preview of its new V4 model specifically adapted for Huawei chip technology, demonstrating China's growing AI capabilities and push for tech autonomy.

articles.title: US State Department Orders Global Warning About Alleged China AI Thefts
articles.summary: The U.S. State Department has ordered a global diplomatic push to highlight widespread efforts by Chinese companies, including DeepSeek, to allegedly steal intellectual property from U.S. AI labs.

articles.title: Cohere Acquires German AI Company Aleph Alpha
articles.summary: Canadian AI company Cohere announces acquisition of German AI firm Aleph Alpha to expand European presence and compete with dominant American AI companies, creating a transatlantic AI powerhouse.

articles.title: Tesla Increases Spending Plan to $25B
articles.summary: Tesla announces increased capital expenditure plan to $25 billion, with significant investments directed toward AI, chips, and robotics development to advance autonomous driving technology.

articles.title: Microsoft Plans First-Ever Voluntary Employee Buyout for 7% of U.S. Workforce
articles.summary: Microsoft announces a voluntary buyout program targeting 7% of its U.S. workforce, part of broader restructuring efforts amid the AI transformation and changing workplace dynamics.

articles.title: China's Caocao Plans Delivery of Fully Customised Robotaxis
articles.summary: Geely's autonomous driving subsidiary Caocao announces plans to deploy thousands of fully customized robotaxis by 2027, advancing China's autonomous vehicle industry.

articles.title: Anthropic Created Test Marketplace for Agent-on-Agent Commerce
articles.summary: Anthropic develops an experimental marketplace where AI agents can conduct commerce with each other, exploring new paradigms in autonomous AI economic interactions.

articles.title: US Justice Department Intervenes in xAI Challenge to Colorado Tech Law
articles.summary: The U.S. Justice Department gets involved in xAI's legal challenge to Colorado technology regulations, highlighting federal interest in AI governance and oversight.

articles.title: Amazon Chips Get Boost from Meta, Giving Cloud Giant Another Path to Win in AI
articles.summary: Amazon's custom AI chips receive a significant boost from Meta's adoption, providing AWS with competitive advantages in the cloud AI infrastructure market.

articles.title: Musk v. Altman Trial Heads to Court
articles.summary: The legal battle between Elon Musk and Sam Altman over OpenAI's direction heads to trial, with Musk seeking billions in damages and potential implications for AI industry governance.
